comment: The tests' world of three regions (docs/world.md, Testing), in the shape of shared/world.json, given to the engine in its place (the WebAssembly's content_use, useContent in src/engine/wasm.ts; ruina_engine::open::fixture in Rust; ?fixture=world in the page on a development server). Emberholm round the origin, as it is in the game; Saltmere across a chunk of open sea to its west (x 1024 to 2048 m); and Thornmarch beside Saltmere across a land border at x = 2048 m, one island grown half by each from its own recipe (tests/fixtures/world/regions/). Crossed on foot, swimming, by cart with a passenger and by glider: crates/engine/src/open/fixture.rs, tests/integration/bigworld.spec.ts.
